verses.ar:
قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ قَمَرٌ سِيدْنَا النَّبِي قَمَرٌ
وَجَمِيل وَجَمِيل وَجَمِيل سِيدْنَا النَّبِي وَجَمِيل
verses.tr:
Qamarun, qamarun, qamarun, sīdna-n-nabī qamarun
Wa jamīl, wa jamīl, wa jamīl, sīdna-n-nabī wa jamīl
verses.en:
Brilliant like the moon — Oh our master the Prophet, Brilliant like the moon!
Beautiful — Oh our master the Prophet, Beautiful!

verses.ar:
وَكَفُّ الْمُصْطَفَى كَالْوَرْدِ نَادِي (اللّٰهْ اللّٰهْ)
وَعِطْرُهَا يَبْقَى إِذَا مَسَّتْ أَيَادِي (اللّٰهْ اللّٰهْ)
verses.tr:
Wa kaffu-l-Muṣṭafā ka-l-wardi nādī (Allāh Allāh)
Wa ʿiṭruhā yabqā idhā massat ayādī (Allāh Allāh)
verses.en:
And your palm like a flower mist by the dew (Allah, Allah)
Its fragrance everlasting where it touches! (Allah, Allah)

verses.ar:
وَعَمَّ نَوَالُهَا كُلَّ الْعِبَادِي (3)
حَبِيبُ اللّٰهِ يَا خَيْرَ الْبَرَايَا
verses.tr:
Wa ʿamma nawāluhā kulla-l-ʿibādī (3)
Ḥabību-llāhi yā khayra-l-barāyā
verses.en:
Its generosity ever extended to all humanity (3)!
So beloved to Allah oh you the best of creation!

verses.ar:
وَلَا ظِلُّ لَّهُ بَلْ كَانَ نُورَا (اللّٰهْ اللّٰهْ)
تَنَالَ الشَّمْسَ مِنْهُ وَالْبُدُورَ (اللّٰهْ اللّٰهْ)
verses.tr:
Wa lā ẓillu lahū bal kāna nūrā (Allāh Allāh)
Tanāla-sh-shamsa minhu wa-l-budūra (Allāh Allāh)
verses.en:
Shade-less but brilliant you ever are (Allah, Allah)
The sun and stars feed off your light! (Allah, Allah)

verses.ar:
وَلَمْ يَكُنِ الْهُدَى لَوْلَا ظُهُورَه (3)
وَكُلُّ الْكَوْنِ أَنَارُ بِنُورِ طَه
verses.tr:
Wa lam yakuni-l-hudā lawlā ẓuhūrah (3)
Wa kullu-l-kawni anāru bi-nūri Ṭāhā
verses.en:
Guidance would have not been possible without you (3)
You have summoned the Cosmos willingly!
